leads.name: Big Tree, Tsitsikamma (reader's tip)
leads.reason: Reader: an Outeniqua yellowwood of 600 to 800 years, about 37 m tall, a protected Champion Tree; reader's girth 900 cm. Needs two sources (or a register plus a life check) and a pin resolved from the reader's map link before it ships as a reader-found tree; nothing found against it.
